cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of RF Challenge-Response Messages and Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.
The Key Fob shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Side-Channel Analysis / Fault Injection Testing

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent unauthorized vehicle wake-up and challenge emission.
The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall enforce the Availability of the LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent denial of legitimate vehicle access and immobilization.

The Vehicle RF Antenna shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of the RF Transceiver to Vehicle Antenna RF Link against Physical Access to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry or start via relay or replay attacks.

The Vehicle RF Antenna shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of the RF Transceiver to Vehicle Antenna RF Link against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle access, engine start, or denial of service.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Physical Tamper Assessment / RF Protocol Analysis

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of Auth Data and RF Transceiver Firmware against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and engine start.

The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of Auth Data and RF Transceiver Firmware against ATM-T0073: Physical Access to prevent unauthorized disclosure of authentication data that could facilitate further attacks.

The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent denial of vehicle access and engine start for legitimate users.

The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of Firmware and Configuration against Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent unauthorized unlocking of doors, unauthorized engine start, and compromise of authentication processes.

The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Door Lock/Unlock Command and Engine Start Command log records against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent denial of command issuance and ensure accountability during forensic investigations.

The Body Control Module (BCM) shall protect the Confidentiality and Integrity of Firmware, Configuration, and Access Policies against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent unauthorized extraction or manipulation of sensitive information leading to bypass of authentication or access control.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Interface and Side Channel Analysis

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of LF Proximity Signal and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized denial of vehicle access and operation.

The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Restricted HSM API and Start Authorization Token against Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent unauthorized engine start or door unlocking.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Interface Access Control Validation

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Door Lock/Unlock Command and CAN Lock/Unlock Message against ATM-T0067: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Affecting Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized door unlocking or blocking of legitimate locking commands.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Firmware Analysis / CAN Message Injection Test

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Availability, Integrity, and Authenticity of CAN Lock/Unlock Message and Door ECU -> Actuator Signal against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent loss of electronic door locking and unlocking functionality.

The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Start Authorization Token and CAN Lock/Unlock Message against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized unlocking of vehicle doors.

The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of the Engine Start Command and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0031: Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of the Start Authorization Token on the Powertrain Start Interface against Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Availability, Authenticity, and Integrity of the Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized immobilization of the vehicle by blocking legitimate engine start requests.
The CAN Bus shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Lock/Unlock and Start Authorization Messages against Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry and engine start.

The CAN Bus shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of In-Vehicle CAN communication against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent denial of service for keyless entry and engine start functions.

The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material and Firmware against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized vehicle access, starting, or fleet-wide key compromise.

The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, and Non-repudiation of HSM Attestation / Measurement Data against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent undetected unauthorized cryptographic operations and loss of forensic traceability.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Test / Audit Log Review / Attestation Verification

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material and Secure Boot Measurements against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, starting, or firmware manipulation.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Side-Channel and Fault Injection Analysis

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Availability, Authenticity, and Integrity of the Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent legitimate users from being unable to unlock or start the vehicle.

The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of the Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0031: Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent unauthorized cryptographic operations, extraction of sensitive data, and unauthorized vehicle access or starting.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Testing / API Authentication and Authorization Validation

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, Authenticity, and Availability of Cryptographic Key Material and HSM Firmware / Secure Boot Measurements against ATM-T0066: Standard Cryptographic Protocol to prevent unauthorized disclosure, manipulation, or exfiltration of cryptographic secrets and compromise of secure enclave trustworthiness.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Firmware Analysis / Secure Boot Validation

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Availability of Cryptographic Key Material and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0067: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Affecting Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry, engine start, or denial of service to legitimate users.
cybersecurity_goals.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle / HSM Firmware and Diagnostic Interfaces
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Firmware Integrity Verification / Interface Security Assessment

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall protect the Confidentiality and Integrity of HSM Internal Bus and Key Access against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent leakage of cryptographic key usage patterns or intermediate data that could enable cryptanalysis or future key extraction.

The Cryptographic Key Store shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, Authenticity, and Availability of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0073: Physical Access to prevent unauthorized extraction or modification of private keys leading to vehicle theft or unauthorized access.

The Cryptographic Key Store shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against Physical Access attacks using side-channel or fault injection techniques to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry, engine start, and key cloning.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Side-Channel and Fault Injection Analysis

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Authenticity, Availability, Confidentiality, and Integrity of Door Lock/Unlock Command and Door ECU -> Actuator Signal against ATM-T0069: Local Function to prevent unauthorized unlocking or denial of locking, thereby maintaining vehicle physical security.

The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Availability, Integrity, and Authenticity of the Actuator Control Signal against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent denial of legitimate vehicle access or egress for authorized users.

The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Engine Start Command and Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0067: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Affecting Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized engine start or manipulation of propulsion controls leading to vehicle theft or unsafe operation.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Interface Fuzzing / Security Audit

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Availability, Authenticity, and Integrity of the Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent vehicle immobilization.

The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, Availability, and Confidentiality of the Software Update Mechanism for the Engine Start Command and Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0021: Disable Software Update to prevent persistent unauthorized engine starts and loss of remediation capability.

The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall enforce the Authenticity and Availability of LF Proximity Signal and LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized wake events leading to battery drain or denial of service.

The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of the LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent denial of legitimate vehicle entry and engine start for authorized users.

The Passive Keyless Entry System shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of LF Proximity Signals and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and engine starting.

The Communication Modules and ECUs (RF Transceiver, BCM, HSM) shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of Firmware and Secure Boot Measurements against Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent unauthorized manipulation of authentication flows, unauthorized vehicle access, and compromise of cryptographic secrets.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Secure Boot Verification / Firmware Integrity Check

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Vehicle Communication Interfaces shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of LF Proximity Signal, RF Challenge-Response Messages, and In-Vehicle CAN against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent vehicle lockout or immobilization.

The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Restricted HSM API and BCM to RF Transceiver Control Interface against ATM-T0050: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Lateral Movement to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry or engine start.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Interface Penetration Testing / API Authentication Validation

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The RF Communication Module shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of Challenge-Response Nonces and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or engine start.

The Keyless Entry and Start System shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Integrity of Message Annotations and Protocol Metadata against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent attackers from crafting or timing attacks that could compromise vehicle access or operation.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Design Review / Static Analysis / Penetration Testing

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of RF receive metadata against Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting due to relay attacks or distance fraud.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Firmware Integrity Test / Metadata Manipulation Simulation

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The LF Antenna System shall enforce the Availability of the LF Proximity Trigger Signal against Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent denial of legitimate vehicle access or start initiation.

The RF Transceiver shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of RF Challenge Messages against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent denial of service or manipulation of the authentication process.

The RF Transceiver shall enforce the Authenticity and Confidentiality of RF Challenge-Response Messages between the Key Fob and Vehicle against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and engine start.

The Body Control Module and Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of CAN lock/unlock messages against Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry, theft, or denial of access to legitimate users.

The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of start authorization commands received from the BCM against Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

The RF transceiver and BCM shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, and Availability of Auth Data against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent authentication failures or unauthorized vehicle access.

The BCM-HSM Interface shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Restricted API Calls against ATM-T0067: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Affecting Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized actuation of vehicle functions such as door unlocking and engine starting.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Interface Access Control Validation

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The HSM-to-BCM Communication Channel shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Verification Results and Authorization Tokens against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, engine start, or leakage of cryptographic material.
cybersecurity_goals.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle Network (CAN bus) between HSM_1 and BCM_1
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Interface Monitoring / Message Authentication Validation

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Integrity and Availability of actuator command messages to the Door Lock Actuator against ATM-T0069: Local Function to prevent unauthorized locking, unlocking, or denial of access to the vehicle.
cybersecurity_goals.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle Network (CAN) / Door ECU to Door Lock Actuator Interface

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Engine ECU shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, and Availability of start enable command messages from the Start Authorization ECU against ATM-T0067: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Affecting Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized engine start or denial of propulsion.
The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of unlock command authorization tokens against ATM-T0069: Local Function to prevent unauthorized physical access to the vehicle.
cybersecurity_goals.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle (CAN bus communication between BCM and Door ECU)
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Message Replay and Injection Testing

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Hardware Security Module (HSM) shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material during internal communication between the Crypto Engine and the Cryptographic Key Store against ATM-T0074: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol to Temporarily Modify Execution to prevent unauthorized key extraction, key modification, and compromise of the vehicle's keyless entry and start system.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Interface Fuzzing / Code Review

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Start Authorization Tokens on the BCM_1 to ECU_START communication against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

The BCM-to-RF Transceiver Control Interface shall enforce the Integrity, Availability, and Authenticity of challenge payloads and transmission parameters against Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized challenge emissions, denial of service, and facilitation of relay or brute-force attacks.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Interface Fuzzing / Penetration Testing / Message Authentication Validation

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The RF Antenna Feed shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of RF Signal Transmission between RF_1 and ANT_RF_1 against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, starting, or denial of legitimate user access.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Physical Penetration Test / Signal Integrity Analysis

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The LF Receiver and BCM shall enforce the Authenticity and Confidentiality of LF_RX_1 -> BCM_1 communications against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, starting, and battery depletion.

The HSM-to-BCM Communication Interface shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of HSM attestation and measurement reports against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent the BCM from trusting compromised or falsified HSM states.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Interface Message Integrity Verification
